title: Runtimes
description: The runtime configuration file: the runtimes that panes can run in, by name.

lead.description:
An interactive step of the start. One waiting pane runs it on its own terminal and
reports the result.

prefix.description: The argv that goes before `ko enter` in a pane's program.

socket.description: Where the runtime's socket is reached inside the runtime. Default: the host path.

up.description: A step of the start that the server runs as its own child. Exit 0 continues the start.

PathMap.description: A directory of the host and the directory of the runtime that holds the same files.

cwd.description: The directory inside the runtime for a pane whose request names none that maps.

env.description: Variables for every pane of the runtime, applied before the variables of the request.

paths.description:
A host directory that a host caller names as cwd maps to the runtime directory of the
longest matching host prefix.

oneOf.description:
A runtime on the host, for the tests of the link machinery. The server accepts it only
with KO_RUNTIME_COMMAND_KIND=1 in its environment.
